title: ADR 0052 recommendation register
supports: Twelve bounded architecture, source-disposition, publication, migration, and closure recommendations.
claim_boundary: Recommendations do not themselves record human acceptance or implementation.

title: ADR 0052 decision approvals
supports: P. Steward acceptance of DM-01 through DM-12 with explicit conditions and holds.
claim_boundary: Acceptance approves architecture and review work but does not change source or generated artifacts.

title: Field-key and lookup-binding audits
supports: Twenty-one field-key issues and 41 unmatched lookup pairs retained for source disposition.
claim_boundary: Registers identify review cases but do not authorize inferred corrections or fuzzy joins.

title: Unit mapping audit
supports: Sixty-four unresolved unit rows and two conflicting ZMK/ha rows retained for review.
claim_boundary: No canonical unit identifier or numeric conversion is approved by acceptance.

title: Consumer contract differences
supports: Forty-four recorded consumer differences support release pinning and compatibility gates.
claim_boundary: Differences do not prove consumer migration or end-to-end parity.
